site.title: Case Studies
site.tagline: Data analysis, Power BI dashboards and automation, built end to end.
site.intro: Each case study takes a common business problem and solves it with Python or Power BI, checks every result with automated tests or an independent reference, and ends with a ready-to-share result. All scenarios and data are fictitious.

cases.title: Automated Sales Report
cases.scenario: Brightleaf Supplies, a fictitious home-and-office goods retailer with four branches
cases.problem: Monthly sales reports built by hand in spreadsheets are slow, error-prone and inconsistent from one month to the next.
cases.solution: One command turns a sales file into a self-contained HTML report with KPI cards, charts by month, branch and category, and a top-products ranking.
cases.result: The full report is rebuilt in about a second, with identical numbers for identical input.
cases.image_alt: Sales report with KPI cards and a monthly revenue chart

cases.title: Sales & Inventory Dashboard (Power BI)
cases.scenario: The same fictitious retailer, two years of sales and month-end stock across four branches and twelve products
cases.problem: Sales, margin and stock live in separate spreadsheets, so managers cannot see whether growth comes with healthy margins or where products run out.
cases.solution: A star-schema Power BI model with 20 DAX measures (time intelligence, semi-additive stock) and three report pages drawn with SVG measures in native visuals.
cases.result: Every number in the report matches an independent Python reference, from yearly revenue down to monthly stockout rates.
cases.image_alt: The three Power BI report pages: sales overview, branches and products, and inventory
